title: Sleep Progress Bar
description: Adds a animated progress bar while while you sleep
body:
![Sleep Progress Bar Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XgsuLb0w/images/8f600761a043bdff167aa70d734c3e22070f97bb.gif)

Sleep Progress Bar is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod that makes sleeping feel clearer and more polished. When your player gets into a bed, the mod displays a centered moonlit status panel with a smooth blue-to-purple progress bar, an animated “Sleeping...” label, and a percentage readout so you can see exactly how close the sleep timer is to completion.

## Features

- Shows a clean sleep progress bar while the player is in bed.
- Displays the current sleep progress as a percentage.
- Adds a subtle animated glow at the end of the filling bar.
- Uses a compact HUD overlay that only appears while sleeping.
- Purely visual; it does not change Minecraft’s sleep mechanics, time skipping, or multiplayer sleep rules.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.21.11
- Mod loader: Fabric
- Fabric Loader: 0.19.0 or newer
- Java: 21+
- Client-side: Required
- Server-side: Unsupported / not needed

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.11.
2. Drop `sleep-progress-bar-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods` folder.
3. Launch the game and sleep in a bed to see the overlay.
